goal.initial_goal: Refactor meight from per-repo daemons to a robust single daemon with repository-scoped worker state, lifecycle cleanup, documentation updates, and verification.
success_criteria: A single default daemon socket/state home is shared across repositories while worker outputs remain repository-scoped.
Completed workers and idle daemons have explicit cleanup policy instead of lingering indefinitely.
CLI commands keep current repository ergonomics for start/wait/status/result/follow/reply.
README, SPEC, and ARCHITECTURE describe the new contract.
Static, focused functional, and live smoke verification pass or documented risks are reported.

requirement_refs.summary: Global daemon coordinates workers across repositories without losing repo-local status/result ergonomics.
Daemon and worker lifecycle should not leave completed work resident forever.

invariant_refs.summary: wait exit codes remain stable: 0 completed, 1 timeout, 2 failed/interrupted, 3 final QUESTION, 4 daemon dead.
Worker status/result files remain durable and readable without daemon streaming.

inputs: meight CLI command plus invoking cwd/--cwd

progress.step: Initialized checkpoint and confirmed root-cause-first direction.
Implemented global daemon home, repository namespace routing, worker GC/idle lifecycle hooks, restart follow resume, dispatch/reply idle shutdown option, and launchd management commands.
Live restart-follow verification found thread_resume fails for ephemeral threads; changed thread_start to ephemeral=False and documented the persistent-thread requirement.
evidence: live output: InvalidRequestError no rollout found for thread id before fix

progress.step: Completed static and live verification for global daemon behavior, repo namespace isolation, restart follow resume, terminal worker GC, idle shutdown, launchd plist payload, and whitespace check.

Applied user requirement that meight workers should not appear as Codex Desktop main threads by making ThreadSource.subagent explicit by default, recording thread_source in status, and documenting --main-thread as the visible opt-in.

Addressed independent review findings: normalized MEIGHT_HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME to absolute paths and added repo column to all-repos status table. Confirmed Korean README sandbox default already matched full.
Completed independent re-review and final focused review; both returned GO after fixes.

verification_matrix.command: focused functional tests using temporary MEIGHT_HOME and two git repos
verification_matrix.details: Temporary MEIGHT_HOME live test passed: same worker name in two git repos shared one daemon pid but wrote separate repo-key status/result trees; list --all-repos returned both.

verification_matrix.command: live meight smoke with global daemon
verification_matrix.details: Live smoke passed: daemon restarted, follow resumed original thread id via thread_resume after persistent thread_start; worker GC logged, disk artifacts remained, idle daemon exited after 2s.

handoff.current_state: Global daemon refactor, lifecycle cleanup, hidden subagent default, documentation, verification, and independent reviews are complete.

decisions.reason: The per-repo daemon topology and missing lifecycle owner are architectural causes; a local cleanup workaround would leave the same pattern recurring.
alternatives_considered: Keep per-repo daemon and add idle cleanup only
decisions.impact: Broader but cleaner topology change with explicit lifecycle semantics.
